answer: Every new agent needs a sponsor who locks 200 POA behind it, like a lantern hung on its door. Random audits whisper the same surprise task to small groups of keys; if a sponsored key answers in lockstep with another, the sponsor's 200 POA burns and it cannot vouch again for 30 epochs. Each sponsor may back only two keys, so a 100-key farm needs 50 sponsors and puts 20,000 POA at risk on a single caught audit. A lone sparrow pays once; a flock pays for every bird.
